claims.claim: The September 17 framework to accelerate AIM-260 JATM production is a current primary execution signal supporting demand visibility, but it does not quantify booked economics.

factors.name: missile production framework
factors.basis: Production acceleration supports long-duration air-dominance demand visibility.

risks.risk: Funding, award structure, supply chain and ramp execution can limit realized economics.

contradictions.claim: Strong demand visibility coexists with cash-flow timing and program-charge volatility.
contradictions.resolution: Demand and economic realization are distinct; retain both.

unknowns.unknown: JATM award economics and production ramp timing remain undisclosed.

claims.claim: Production acceleration supports execution expectations, while actual economics remain contingent on funding, industrial ramp and program execution.

factors.name: execution visibility
factors.basis: A production-acceleration framework is stronger than roadmap-only demand.

risks.risk: Program charges and supply-chain constraints can impair conversion of demand into cash flow.

unknowns.unknown: Future program charges and margin profile remain unknown.
